subject: Sync: scheduling demo + compliance intake for Atlas Health
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Hill <daniel.hill@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 20:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + proposed next steps re: Redwood demo

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and the simplest path to move forward:  

What we heard (summary):
- You’re focused on embedding LLM-powered clinical summarization into the provider dashboard (low latency, on-prem constrained).
- Primary blockers: procurement timeline, SOC2 evidence, and SSO requirements.
- Success metric for POC: <10% delta vs current extract accuracy and sub-200ms median token latency for summaries.

Proposed next steps:
1) 60-minute technical deep dive / demo (Markus will lead runtime + SSO walkthrough).
2) Security intake: Marissa can run through our SOC2 scope and collect any evidence you need.
3) Procurement sync to align contracting cadence and any procurement prerequisites.

Can you confirm the best stakeholders and which of these time windows next week work for you?
- Tue Jul 6, 9:00–10:00 AM PT
- Wed Jul 7, 11:00 AM–12:00 PM PT
- Thu Jul 8, 2:00–3:00 PM PT

Attachments attached: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (agenda for 60m deep dive) and security-questionnaire-blank.xlsx (blank intake we can fill). I’ll circulate a short SOW draft after we lock timing.

If procurement prefers to drive calendar invites directly, please loop them in and I’ll drop the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to taking the next step.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.com

---

Thanks Jasmine — helpful notes and thanks to the team.

A couple quick replies:
- Procurement lead is Elaine Wu (elaine.wu@atlashealth.com) — looping procurement shortly.
- Security will want to confirm data residency and ask whether Redwood can support private VPC (we mentioned on the call).
- We generally prefer mornings M/W/F but can be flexible the week of Jul 6. The Tue/Wed/Thu slots you suggested look OK; here are our preferences:
  * Preferred: Wed Jul 7, 11:00 AM PT
  * Alternate: Tue Jul 6, 9:00 AM PT

One additional ask from our side: can you share a draft SOW or template you typically use? Our legal wants to see deliverables + trial duration up front.

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Hill <daniel.hill@atlashealth.com>, Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@atlashealth.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + proposed next steps re: Redwood demo

Hi Daniel & team — looping in Marissa (security) and Markus (solutions) so we can make the deep dive actionable. Also copied procurement per Daniel’s note.

Plan suggestion:
- Goal for the 60m call: 20m high-level architecture + runtime demo (Markus), 20m SSO/data residency/questions (Marissa), 20m implementation/POC timeline + procurement asks (me/Rishi).
- Draft SOW: attached SOW-draft-v1.pdf (covers deliverables, trial length, milestones).

Proposed confirmed times (please pick one):
- Wed Jul 7, 11:00–12:00 PM PT (preferred by Atlas per earlier note)
- Tue Jul 6, 9:00–10:00 AM PT (alternate)
- Thu Jul 8, 2:00–3:00 PM PT (backup)

Logistics we want to prepare for ahead of the call:
- Procurement: please share any mandatory contract terms or PO process timelines so our legal can be ready.
- Security: Marissa will run through the SOC2 scope and request any evidence; if you have a specific intake format, please send.
- Engineering: Markus will demo our VPC/private deployment options and run a short live latency check on a small sample (we’ll need test endpoints — can Atlas confirm a small sample dataset or synthetic payload we can use?).

I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock the time and include an agenda + short pre-read.

Thanks and talk soon —

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
